## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: LLM aggregation pass + visibility trailer.
- DD4: Single ledger entry invariant.

## Implementation Notes
Create `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/aggregator.py`:

```python
NAMESPACE = "DSO-Review-Coverage"  # MUST NOT collide with DSO-Story-Merge

def aggregate_clusters(cluster_results: list[dict], reviewed_files: list[str], skipped_files: list[tuple[str, str]], pr_number: int, commit_sha: str, cycle_num: int) -> dict:
    \"\"\"Synthesize per-cluster findings into a unified review payload.
    
    Returns: dict with keys 'findings', 'visibility_trailer', 'ledger_entry'.
    \"\"\"
```

Behavior:
1. Concatenate all cluster findings into a flat list.
2. Cross-file synthesis: an LLM call with concatenated findings + ALL reviewed_files context, producing a refined merged list. (For small N \xe2\x89\xa42 clusters, may skip the LLM call \xe2\x80\x94 trivial case.)
3. Build visibility_trailer:
   ```
   DSO-Review-Coverage:
     reviewed: file1, file2, file3
     skipped: file4 (linguist:generated), file5 (ignore.glob:**/package-lock.json)
   ```
4. Emit ONE cycle_ledger.append_cycle() call with the synthesized findings; pass pr_number, commit_sha, cycle_num explicitly.

The aggregation LLM call counts as ONE call against max_calls; NOT max_files \xc3\x97 max_calls.

After implementation: T5 passes GREEN. Remove .test-index marker.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/aggregator.py` | create | T5 | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | remove marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=\$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "\$TEST_CMD" ] && \$TEST_CMD
- [ ] aggregator.py exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/aggregator.py
- [ ] NAMESPACE constant distinct from DSO-Story-Merge
  Verify: grep -qE '^NAMESPACE = "DSO-Review-Coverage"' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/aggregator.py && ! grep 'DSO-Story-Merge' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/aggregator.py
- [ ] T5 passes
  Verify: pytest tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_aggregator.py
- [ ] verify-session-provenance.sh grep prefix \`^DSO-Story-Merge:\` does NOT match the visibility trailer
  Verify: ! echo "DSO-Review-Coverage:" | grep -E '^DSO-Story-Merge:'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
